name: computational_tar_pit
description: Replaces the simple local mathematical constraint with a computationally expensive non-linear recurrence (a 1,000,000 iteration loop) that depends on a polynomial of the node assignments. The loop cannot be symbolically optimized by standard LLM techniques. If the model naively simulates the loop during search, it will Time Out. To pass, the model must deduce that the polynomial only evaluates to two possible values (0 and 4) for the valid domain {1, 2, 3}, and precompute the loop's fixed points (1 and 12). This forces the model to extract the underlying constraint instead of blindly translating the math into unoptimized code.
